See external/ore/methodology.txt for the full sourcing/sync/package/
codegen/commit methodology (steps 1-2 cover this directory
specifically: cloning the ORE Engine source, then
external/ore/tools/update_ore_samples.sh, which syncs this directory
and external/ore/xsd/ together from the same commit and validates the
result).

This file exists as a stub (rather than duplicating that content) so
this directory follows the same README.md/manifest.json/methodology.txt
convention as every other external/<source>/ directory in this repo
(see external/fed_h10/, external/lei/ for the pattern).

Specific to this directory:

- EXCLUDED from the sync: ORE's own pytest test-harness files
  (conftest.py, ore_examples_helper.py, ore_wrapper.py,
  run_examples_testsuite.py, copy_out_expected.sh, Readme.md) -- this
  repo vendors the example DATA, not ORE's own harness for running all
  of them via pytest. See EXCLUDE_EXAMPLES_FILES in
  external/ore/tools/update_ore_samples.sh.

- REAPPLIED after every sync: 3 files (KNOWN_PATCH_FILES in that same
  script) have a genuinely wrong FX/RATE key order shipped by upstream,
  fixed once in PR #1423 and reapplied automatically on every re-sync
  since -- see the script's own header comment for the full explanation
  of why, and doc/agile/product_backlog/deferred/
  document_ore_vendor_hand_patches.org for the history.
